verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine ships a Remote Control web server with HTTP/WebSocket APIs, so credential scoping for agent access is a fair axis. However, the evidence never documents issuing API keys, tokens, or least-privilege credentials. Remote Control Presets control which project content is exposed, but that is an adjacent exposure control, not scoped credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
